goal: Allow Bitcoin Core wallet users to send bitcoin to BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses
Enable transacting with recipients using Silent Payments to prevent address reuse and improve privacy
Provide built-in sending support without requiring users to rely on third-party wallets
reviewability: Reviewable now, with nothing known that would invalidate a review
agreement: Blocked by multiple unaddressed correctness objections with no author reply yet
Unaddressed objection: leaf-only Taproot inputs cause output creation failures (Yudis-bit)
Unaddressed objection: fee bumping erases recipient metadata, risking permanent loss (Yudis-bit)
Unaddressed objection: MSVC build fails from deleted move constructor in walletmodel (Yudis-bit)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because the RPC changes provide niche diagnostic tooling rather than primary node workflows
Value is confined to developers inspecting transactions for silent payment outputs

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it delivers a major user-facing feature enabling payments to silent payment addresses
Wallet users gain substantial privacy and address reuse protection without external software
Unblocks Bitcoin Core participation in the wider BIP 352 ecosystem
